  ▾ All columns                                                            a
  Context 530 · 10.59 ms/token. No model = measured time, unknown savings.
  Roofline is an upper bound. Captured 11.8 ms; untraced 10.6 ms.
  Difference: +1.2 ms; the capture adds 1.2 ms a token over the engine's 766
  launches a token, 1.6 us each, and 79% of those launches take under 10 us:
  a cost per launch weighs on an engine that splits its token into many
  short kernels. capture +11.53% over native, above the 5% capture-overhead
  ceiling. +tok/s allocates headroom by time difference; cumulative
  reconciles the roofline. These are accounting shares, not predicted
  speedups.
